cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Change What the Apology Is For
cards.instruction: Get an apology, then reveal that the original offense was only the first layer of what needs repair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Thank you for apologising for missing my concert.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Closer. Now why did I have to ask whether you'd noticed missing it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I didn't know what to say.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then apologise for letting me rehearse your apology alone all week.

mechanism: Copy a concert conductor's bow as thanks to the audience, then expand a missed-concert apology into an apology for leaving A performing the wrong gratitude ritual.
confusable: Not just two grievances stacked: B2's correction must reveal what the initial absence cost and lead to a specific further repair.
comparison: Concert performer and absent friend versus housemates whose copied dog-scolding followed a broken vase.
seedUse: Retains missed concert apology and loneliness afterward; introduces mistaken copied bow and request to witness the ending.
